items.title: China Presses EU Over Subsidy Rules
items.english: Politico Europe reports that China has linked the EU's foreign subsidies rules to wider trade talks with Brussels. Beijing has told Chinese companies not to hand some information to EU investigators, while the EU says the rules protect fair competition. The dispute could make negotiations harder as both sides try to manage tensions over industry, public contracts and electric vehicles.
items.chinese: Politico Europe 报道，中国把欧盟的外国补贴规则与更广泛的中欧贸易谈判联系起来。北京已要求中国企业不要向欧盟调查人员提交部分信息，而欧盟则表示这些规则是在保护公平竞争。随着双方试图处理产业、公共合同和电动汽车方面的紧张关系，这一争议可能让谈判更加困难。

english.text: Politico Europe reports that China has linked the EU's foreign subsidies rules to wider trade talks with Brussels.
Beijing has told Chinese companies not to hand some information to EU investigators, while the EU says the rules protect fair competition.
The dispute could make negotiations harder as both sides try to manage tensions over industry, public contracts and electric vehicles.

items.title: Migrant Boat Sinks Near Tunisia
items.english: Al Jazeera reports that at least 14 people are missing after a boat carrying migrants sank off Tunisia while heading toward Italy. One person was rescued, according to Tunisian officials. The accident underlines the danger of the central Mediterranean route, where people continue to risk small boats despite stronger border controls and repeated deadly crossings.
items.chinese: Al Jazeera 报道，一艘载有移民、驶往意大利方向的船只在突尼斯海域沉没后，至少 14 人失踪。突尼斯官员表示，有一人获救。此事凸显中地中海路线的危险性，尽管边境管控加强、致命事故反复发生，仍有人冒险乘坐小船出海。

One person was rescued, according to Tunisian officials.
The accident underlines the danger of the central Mediterranean route, where people continue to risk small boats despite stronger border controls and repeated deadly crossings.

items.title: Chinese Carrier Expands Arctic Route
items.english: gCaptain reports that China's NewNew Shipping Line has delivered container cargo to Murmansk through the Northern Sea Route for the first time. The ship sailed from Tianjin with automotive parts and about 500 containers. The voyage shows growing interest in Arctic shipping, especially from Asian operators seeking alternative links between China, Russia and Europe.
items.chinese: gCaptain 报道，中国 NewNew Shipping Line 首次通过北方海航道向摩尔曼斯克交付集装箱货物。该船从天津出发，载有汽车零部件和约 500 个集装箱。这次航行显示出亚洲运营商对北极航运的兴趣正在上升，尤其是寻找连接中国、俄罗斯和欧洲的替代通道。

The ship sailed from Tianjin with automotive parts and about 500 containers.
The voyage shows growing interest in Arctic shipping, especially from Asian operators seeking alternative links between China, Russia and Europe.

items.title: AI Optimism Differs by Age
items.english: Politico Europe reports that new polling finds older and wealthier people are more positive about artificial intelligence than younger adults. The result suggests that AI is not only a technology debate, but also a social one. Younger people may worry more about jobs, fairness and control, while others focus on productivity gains and new services.
items.chinese: Politico Europe 报道，新的民调显示，年纪较大、收入较高的人对人工智能的态度比年轻成年人更积极。结果表明，AI 不只是技术争论，也是社会议题。年轻人可能更担心就业、公平和控制权，而其他人则更关注生产率提升和新服务机会。

The result suggests that AI is not only a technology debate, but also a social one.
Younger people may worry more about jobs, fairness and control, while others focus on productivity gains and new services.

items.title: Ukraine Seeks Missile Defences
items.english: Euronews reports that Ukraine may use part of the EU's 90 billion euro loan to buy anti-ballistic missile systems. Officials say Kyiv is discussing options as Russian strikes continue to hit civilians and infrastructure. The question is politically sensitive because some EU countries want the money to support European defence producers whenever possible.
items.chinese: Euronews 报道，乌克兰可能使用欧盟 900 亿欧元贷款中的一部分购买反弹道导弹系统。官员表示，在俄罗斯持续袭击平民和基础设施之际，基辅正在讨论相关选择。这个问题具有政治敏感性，因为一些欧盟国家希望资金尽可能支持欧洲防务企业。

items.title: TikTok Settles Child Privacy Case
items.english: The Verge reports that TikTok will pay 400 million dollars to settle a US Justice Department lawsuit over children's privacy. The case accused the company of collecting data from young users without proper parental consent and not deleting some accounts when asked. The settlement is a major signal that child safety rules for social platforms are becoming stricter.
items.chinese: The Verge 报道，TikTok 将支付 4 亿美元，以解决美国司法部关于儿童隐私的诉讼。该案指控公司在没有适当家长同意的情况下收集未成年用户数据，并在被要求时未删除部分账户。此和解释放出一个重要信号：社交平台的儿童安全规则正变得更加严格。
